title.value: GAUCHE: A Library for Gaussian Processes in Chemistry
title.justification: The title of the paper is clearly stated at the beginning: 'GAUCHE: A Library for Gaussian Processes in Chemistry'.
title.quote: GAUCHE: A Library for Gaussian Processes in Chemistry Ryan-Rhys Griffiths1∗ Leo Klarner2∗ Henry Moss3∗ Aditya Ravuri3∗ Sang Truong4∗

extractions.description: The paper introduces GAUCHE, an open-source library designed for applying Gaussian processes in chemistry. It highlights the library's capability to extend Gaussian processes to molecular representations, offering modular and robust kernel options. The paper discusses applications of GAUCHE in molecular discovery, chemical reaction optimization, and protein design, aiming to aid chemists and material scientists in leveraging advanced probabilistic modeling techniques.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper revolves around the development and application of a library (GAUCHE) for Gaussian processes in chemistry, focusing on molecular discovery and optimization in a general scientific context rather than specific sustainability or climate change goals.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: By providing such kernels in a modular, robust and easy-to-use framework, we seek to enable expert chemists and materials scientists to make use of state-of-the-art black-box optimization techniques.

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on the development of a computational tool for chemistry rather than directly addressing any of the listed sustainable development categories. Its applications in molecular discovery and optimization do not specifically target ecological or climate-related issues.
primary_category.quote: Motivated by scenarios frequently encountered in practice, we showcase applications for GAUCHE in molecular discovery, chemical reaction optimisation and protein design.

secondary_categories.justification: No secondary sustainable development themes specifically related to climate or ecology are addressed in the paper.
secondary_categories.quote: The codebase is made available at https://github.com/leojklarner/gauche.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper does not align with any specific sub-category under Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development due to its focus on general chemistry and materials science improvements.
primary_sub_category.quote: We provide a modular, robust and easy-to-use framework to rapidly prototype GP S with 30+ GPU-accelerated string, fingerprint and graph kernels.
